title: 豆油間 Tāu-iû-king
subject: a seventy-eight-year-old opening and closing a hundred and twenty soy sauce jars twice a day
caption: Taiwanese Hokkien music built on a Chinese-instrument ensemble with electronics inverted into the accompanying role. Sheng mouth organ holding sustained reedy clusters, liuqin playing rapid plucked figures in the high register, zhongruan filling the middle with round plucked tone, and underneath them granular electronic textures and a deep sub bass that support rather than lead. The traditional ensemble is mixed in front and dry, the electronics sit behind it and wide. Male voice, plain and low, conversational with traditional breath placement and no ornamental crying. 110 BPM, A minor. Time measured in jars rather than clocks. No drum kit, no four-on-the-floor, no suona, no pop chorus, no key change.
lyrics:
[Verse]
巷仔底彼間 做豆油做六十冬
一百二十甕 排佇後壁埕 曝日頭
頭家七十八歲 伊逐工去共甕掀開 閣崁轉去
掀開 崁轉去 一工兩擺 六十冬

[Chorus]
豆油間
時間佇遮 毋是用鐘量的
是用甕 是用日頭 是用一个人的手
六十冬 一个人 一百二十甕

[Verse]
囝孫無人欲接 頭家家己講的 伊無怨
伊講「做這个 愛等 這馬無人欲等」
伊講了閣笑 笑了閣去掀甕
伊的手 比伊的話較誠實

[Chorus]
豆油間
時間佇遮 毋是用鐘量的
是用甕 是用日頭 是用一个人的手
六十冬 一个人 一百二十甕 猶咧算

[Outro]
阮買一矸轉去
阮毋甘開
